description: This file implements a logging communication system for Spark's PySpark ML module, including server and client classes for streaming logs over sockets, with support for thread safety, message truncation, and network handling.

classes.name: WriteLogToStdout
classes.description: Handles reading log messages from a socket stream and writing them to stderr.

classes.name: LogStreamingServer
classes.description: Runs a TCP server to receive and handle log messages, managing server lifecycle and threading.

classes.name: LogStreamingClientBase
classes.description: Base class for log streaming clients, providing message truncation.

classes.name: LogStreamingClient
classes.description: Client class that streams log messages to a LogStreamingServer, with connection management and error handling.

methods.name: _get_log_print_lock
methods.description: Returns the threading lock used for synchronized log printing.

methods.name: WriteLogToStdout._read_bline
methods.description: Generator that reads length-prefixed messages from the socket.

methods.name: WriteLogToStdout.handle
methods.description: Handles incoming socket data and writes log messages to stderr.

methods.name: LogStreamingServer._get_free_port
methods.description: Finds an available TCP port for the server.

methods.name: LogStreamingServer.start
methods.description: Starts the log streaming server in a separate thread.

methods.name: LogStreamingClientBase._maybe_truncate_msg
methods.description: Truncates messages exceeding a specified length.

methods.name: LogStreamingClient.send
methods.description: Sends a message to the server, with message length prefix.

methods.name: LogStreamingClient._connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the server.

methods.name: LogStreamingClient._fail
methods.description: Handles connection or sending failures, issuing warnings.
